summary:
Reviewed PR #22 "Plan an always-on creative cephalon with an independent responsive head" — complete immutable diff (31 files, 394,307 bytes), all 53 pages read and assessed, plus full source of the new diagnostic script/test, the workflow file, and kanban/ledger/receipt context.

Deterministic evidence: 13/13 gates attempted, all exit 0 at exact head on a clean checkout, errors=[], including the newly added cephalon_diagnostic gate (12 tests/93 assertions). workspace_laws log ENOENT lines (opencode/jscpd) are isolated-runner tool availability, not change-introduced failures; evidence_adapter UNAVAILABLE/BLOCKED output is passing-suite fixture content.

Change: one new CI gate pattern-identical to the existing 12; a new read-only diagnostic with fail-closed phase ordering (usage, image digest, manifest shape, per-file sha256, runtime observation), loopback-only credential use, no I/O at import; a fixture/vm test suite that executes the actual shipped observation script; append-only receipts/ledger appends (receipt_history passed); 14 planning cards, notes, and a verification report with consistent UUID cross-refs and story-point sums.

Confirmed findings: none. Three low-severity candidates were registered and all rejected under adversarial validation: (1) multi-level FAIL reporting in the diagnostic count - the count equals the printed FAIL lines and the exit status, its documented purpose, is correct on every path and pinned by tests; (2) mixed scalar/array dependency frontmatter - installed Rheos natively validated the scalar cards, array is pre-existing corpus convention, the projection gap is disclosed and tracked upstream (Rheos issue 3), no board admission claimed, no deterministic gate parses kanban frontmatter; (3) the :end-run-tests defmethod - the exact extension cljs.test documents, already used by five pre-existing suites, only sets exit 1 on failure, gate green with visible output.

Non-blocking notes: real spawnSync nonzero/timeout/ENOENT paths are exercised only through the test stub (fail-closed by construction); external artifact/URL claims in the verification report are not independently verifiable from this runner; cosmetic nits (multi-level FAIL lines, mid-file license line, missing spaces in output strings) match existing repo style.

No demonstrated invariant violation, no confirmed finding, nothing blocking.
